messages:
Jordan: Quick sync for NorthStar POC kickoff Mon AM. Need final answers on: sample payloads (size), client redaction, storage target (S3 preferred), networking choice (VPC peering vs PrivateLink), and trial type (Dedicated vs hosted credits).

Priya: Customer will include PHI. Requesting they run client-side redaction before upload but we must support KMS and object-level audit. Ask them for a 500-1k record sample + schema + 50-prompt eval set.

Devon: SecQ short answer: "Data encrypted at rest with KMS; customer-managed CMKs can be used for Private deployments. CloudTrail and S3 object logging available for audit." Will paste full copy for the questionnaire.

Samir: Pricing options: 14-day Dedicated trial (150 GPU hours) with trial SOW, fallback = $10k hosted credits. Recommend Dedicated if they can approve SOW quickly.

Maya: Proposed success criteria:
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms
- Throughput: 30-40 qps sustained
- Quality: F1 >= 0.7 on their eval set
- Security: no raw PHI in persisted logs or artifacts
Also need their expected SLA window for testing.

infra-bot: Sandbox provisioned: s3://ns-poc-1950 created, presign endpoint https://upload.redwood.example/presign/1950 TTL=12h, VPC endpoint vpce-09a.

Jordan: Action items:
- Priya: request manifest + sample + prompt set (EOD)
- Devon: drop SecQ ready text and infra snippets (EOD)
- Maya: prep eval harness template + scoring script (tomorrow)
- Samir: draft trial SOW (EOD)
Any blockers?

Priya: Pinging customer now for manifest.

Devon: Flag: on-prem HSM during POC requires legal/enterprise signoff and extra lead time.

Jordan: Noted. If no blockers we'll proceed with Dedicated trial offer. Thanks everyone.
